title: 宝象国救公主
subtitle: 星灯迷宫里的回家路
origin: 《西游记》第二十八至三十一回（低龄改编）

moral.zh: 想念陪伴并不等于可以替别人决定去留；真正的朋友会先询问、认真倾听，再一起寻找让彼此安心的办法。
moral.en: Wanting company does not mean choosing for someone else. A true friend asks, listens, and finds a solution that helps everyone feel safe.

pages.zh: 离开白虎岭，师徒来到宝象国。城门旁挂满寻人彩带，国王正盼着失散的百花羞公主回家。
pages.en: After leaving White Tiger Ridge, the travelers reached Baoxiang Kingdom. Ribbons by the gate showed that the king was still hoping Princess Baihuaxiu would come home.

pages.en: The mountain cave was really a bright garden. Princess Baihuaxiu was safe and well in a star-lantern pavilion, but she missed her family, so she folded a peony paper bird to carry clues.
